title: @lindner We are trying to get our first meeting of Known Open Collective going. Trying for Sunday 9am PDT 6/30 since so many of us at #IndieWeb Summit
summary: @lindner We are trying to get our first meeting of Known Open Collective going. Trying for Sunday 9am PDT 6/30 since so many of us at #IndieWeb Summit but @mapkyca is on UK time. Saturday sessions too late. Ping on IRC to RSVP or send rsvp my event page
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@lindner We are trying to get our first meeting of Known Open Collective going. Trying for Sunday 9am PDT 6/30 since so many of us at #IndieWeb Summit but @mapkyca is on UK time.

Saturday sessions too late.

Ping on IRC to RSVP or send rsvp my event page
